<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/usage"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a point-in-time snapshot of the workspace's active remote development sessions: session counts and vCPU/memory totals split by OS, workspace-wide and per user, and the workspace's vCPU quota and use per machine family. This reports sessions currently consuming resources; it is not a historical or billing-period report. Requires the caller to hold the workspace's billing-view permission (workspace owners and billing-managing custom roles); other members receive a permission-denied error.
